name: table-48
description: A table with an inline input row at the bottom for adding new entries.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { PlusIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Input } from "@workspace/ui/components/input" import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption, } from "@workspace/ui/components/native-select" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" export default function AddRowFormTable() { const [guests, setGuests] = React.useState([ { name: "Imogen Clarke", meal: "Vegetarian" }, { name: "Rafael Costa", meal: "Fish" }, ]) const [name, setName] = React.useState("") const [meal, setMeal] = React.useState("Chicken") return (
{ e.preventDefault() if (!name.trim()) return setGuests((g) => [...g, { name: name.trim(), meal }]) setName("") }} > Guest Meal {guests.map((g) => ( {g.name} {g.meal} ))} setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Guest name" className="h-7" aria-label="Guest name" /> setMeal(e.target.value)} aria-label="Meal" > Chicken Fish Vegetarian
) }
